triggers.ACTION_STATEMENT:
SET NEW.dep = (
  SELECT td.`Deposito`
  FROM tab_deposito td
  WHERE TRIM(td.`DIV`) = LEFT(TRIM(NEW.`div`),4)
  LIMIT 1
)

SET NEW.dep = (
  SELECT td.`Deposito`
  FROM tab_deposito td
  WHERE TRIM(td.`DIV`) = TRIM(NEW.`div`)
  LIMIT 1
)

SET NEW.dep = CASE
  WHEN NEW.dep IS NULL
       OR NOT (LEFT(TRIM(NEW.`div`),4) <=> LEFT(TRIM(OLD.`div`),4))
    THEN (SELECT td.`Deposito`
          FROM tab_deposito td
          WHERE TRIM(td.`DIV`) = LEFT(TRIM(NEW.`div`),4)
          LIMIT 1)
  ELSE NEW.dep
END

SET NEW.dep = CASE
  WHEN NEW.dep IS NULL OR NOT (TRIM(NEW.`div`) <=> TRIM(OLD.`div`))
    THEN (SELECT td.`Deposito`
          FROM tab_deposito td
          WHERE TRIM(td.`DIV`) = TRIM(NEW.`div`)
          LIMIT 1)
  ELSE NEW.dep
END

BEGIN
    
    SET NEW.is_driver = CASE 
        WHEN UPPER(TRIM(NEW.qualifica)) = 'AUTISTA' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END;
END

BEGIN
    
    IF NEW.qualifica != OLD.qualifica OR 
       NEW.is_driver != CASE 
           WHEN UPPER(TRIM(NEW.qualifica)) = 'AUTISTA' THEN 1
           ELSE 0
       END THEN
        SET NEW.is_driver = CASE 
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM(NEW.qualifica)) = 'AUTISTA' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END;
    END IF;
END
